Encased in a narrow bezel Shale Black aluminum alloy chassis just 8mm thin and weighing 1.34 pounds, the tablet pairs a sleek, book friendly profile with the durability needed for daily use at home or in the classroom. Its centerpiece is the 13 inch IPS touch display, which renders WUXGA 1920 by 1200 resolution at 350 nits of brightness across a 16 by 10 aspect ratio, giving movies, documents, and games plenty of vivid, detailed screen real estate. Powering that experience is 4GB of LPDDR4X onboard memory alongside 64GB of eMMC storage, with a microSD card slot available to expand capacity by up to 512GB for downloaded media, apps, and files. Dual band 802.11ax Wi-Fi 6 with MU-MIMO technology and Bluetooth 5.4 provide dependable wireless connectivity, while a 2 megapixel front camera and 5 megapixel rear camera handle video calls and casual photography with ease. A 5,000mAh lithium ion battery delivers up to 10 hours of video playback on a single charge, and Widevine L1 certification enables full high definition streaming from platforms such as Netflix and Disney Plus. Google Kids Space adds a parent managed space for younger users, rounding out a tablet built to serve students and families across a wide range of everyday tasks.

items.name: Visual Land - 11" 128GB Tablet - 2-in-1 - MediaTek G99 Octa-Core - FHD Display - Android 15 - Google Gemini - with Pogo Keyboard Case - Rose Gold
items.description: The Visual Land 11” Tablet brings together the productivity of a laptop and the convenience of a tablet in one sleek, versatile 2-in-1 device. Designed for work, study, creativity, and entertainment, the Prestige P11 Pro offers the flexibility and performance to keep up with your everyday needs. Included with the tablet is a detachable pogo keyboard case with an integrated trackpad, instantly transforming the device into a compact, laptop-style workstation with full cursor navigation and precise control. Its convenient plug-and-play design requires no Bluetooth pairing, extra cables, or separate charging, making it easy to switch between tablet and laptop modes. The USB-C port remains fully accessible while the keyboard is attached, allowing you to charge the tablet or connect compatible accessories and external devices. When it's time to relax, simply detach the keyboard and enjoy the freedom and portability of a lightweight tablet. Powered by a MediaTek G99 2.2 GHz Octa-Core processor and 4GB RAM, the Prestige P11 Pro delivers smooth, responsive performance for multitasking, browsing, streaming, gaming, and everyday productivity. Android 15 offers a modern, intuitive interface, while the built-in AI-powered Google Gemini assistant provides convenient hands-free assistance to help you stay organized, find information, and get things done. The vibrant 11-inch In-Cell Full HD IPS touchscreen delivers sharp detail, rich colors, and responsive touch controls, making everything from movies and games to presentations and documents look crisp and immersive. Quad speakers provide rich, powerful audio for music, entertainment, video calls, and virtual meetings. Measuring just 0.30 inches thin, the tablet features an exceptionally slim, lightweight design that's comfortable to hold and easy to take anywhere. With 128GB of onboard storage and support for expansion up to 1TB, there's plenty of room for apps, games, photos, HD videos, music, and important files. Similar to a traditional computer, the tablet also supports multiple user profiles, allowing adults and children to enjoy their own personalized experiences on a single device. A 13MP rear camera and 5MP front-facing camera make it easy to capture photos, stay connected with friends and family, attend virtual classes, and participate in video conferences. A long-lasting battery keeps you productive and entertained throughout the day, reducing the need to constantly search for a charger. Whether you're typing documents, attending meetings, completing schoolwork, browsing the web, or enjoying your favorite entertainment, the Visual Land Prestige P11 Pro effortlessly adapts to your lifestyle. Combining laptop-style functionality, powerful performance, and tablet portability, it's a versatile all-in-one solution designed to help you work smarter, stay connected, and enjoy more wherever life takes you.

items.name: AGPtek - 8 in 1 External CD/DVD Drive for Laptop, USB 3.0 Ultra Slim Portable CD Burner with 4 USB Ports - Black
items.description: AGPTEK External CD/DVD Drive for Laptops - Many modern laptops no longer have built-in CD/DVD drives, making it impossible to insert CDs or DVDs to play music, watch movies, back up data or install systems. The AGPTEK external drive is the perfect solution, plug and play with no additional drivers required. Ensure the drive is recognized: Insert the external optical drive into the computer. After the Windows system recognizes the optical drive, the "DVD RW Drive" icon will be displayed. The Mac OS computer will not display the device icon until the disc is placed in the optical drive and the disc is read successfully. If the computer fails to recognize the optical drive, it may be that the computer's driver is missing or the output current is insufficient. About data cable & power cord: 1.The USB data cable is built into the bottom of the drive.(Note: The total length of the data cable is only about 10.24 inches / 26 cm.) 2.The charging cord is a separate USB cord that comes with the package. The charging cord cannot be used as a data cable alone, it must be used together with the USB data cable built into the back of the drive. 3.It's better to use the 5V charger/power bank to increase the power if your computer don't have enough power to support the external drive. (Note: For the Apple computers, you need to connect the external CD/DVD drive to the mac/macbook/imac through the USB A/C data cable first, and then connect the 5V charger/power bank to the external CD/DVD drive through the charging cord, otherwise the Apple computer will not recognize the external CD/DVD drive.) WINDOWS 11 Requirements: WINDOWS 11 needs a media player (such as VLC ) and a network connection. Reading and writing speed: 1.This CD/DVD drive supports USB 3.0 and can provide data transfer speeds of up to 5Gbps. Although it has up to 8x DVD read/write speed and 24x CD read/write speed, the drive reads and writes CD/DVD discs at speeds that increase from the inner circle to the outer circle, and the starting speed is usually lower, reaching the maximum speed when reaching the outermost circle. 2.Recommended speeds (CD: Reading Speed: 24x or lower/Writing Speed: 8x to 16x; DVD: Reading Speed: 8x or lower/Writing Speed: 4x to 8x). For DVDs, slower writing speeds like 4x or 8x are often ideal to ensure data integrity, particularly for high-capacity or dual-layer discs. These speeds allow for more precise data encoding, reducing the risk of read errors in the future.

This one wires all four SuperSpeed pairs plus both sideband (SBU) pins, so USB 3.2 Gen 2 at 10Gbps and DisplayPort Alt Mode at 4K/60Hz both work. items.name: Plugable - USB C to HDMI Adapter for Dual Monitors, 4K 60Hz USB C Hub for Windows and Chromebook, Driverless - Black
items.description: This Plugable USB-C to HDMI adapter serves as a high-performance alternative to traditional docking stations for Windows and Chromebook users. Built with Multi-Stream Transport (MST) technology, it allows for two independent displays without the need for DisplayLink drivers or external power bricks. While many hubs compromise on refresh rates, this unit supports dual 4K 60Hz output when paired with a host device supporting DisplayPort 1.4 and Display Stream Compression (DSC). For older laptops with DP 1.2, the adapter automatically scales to provide stable dual 1080p 60Hz signals. It is essential to verify that your laptop port is labeled with a Thunderbolt, USB4, or a DP logo, as standard data-only USB-C ports cannot transmit video signals. For Mac and iPad users, please note that Apple devices utilize Single-Stream Transport (SST), which results in the second monitor mirroring the first. This is a hardware limitation of the OS, not the adapter. Setup is straightforward: connect the integrated 17cm cable to your laptop, then use HDMI 2.0 or higher cables to connect your monitors. If your screen does not appear immediately, navigate to your OS Display Settings to ensure "Extend these displays" is selected. This adapter supports High-bandwidth Digital Content Protection (HDCP), ensuring compatibility with encrypted streaming services. It is ideal for office multitasking, financial spreadsheets, and hybrid work environments where a portable, reliable dual-monitor setup is required. The bus-powered design draws minimal energy from your laptop, maintaining efficiency for travelers. By tapping into native GPU capabilities, the USBC-MSTH2 avoids the CPU overhead often associated with driver-based video solutions, providing a smoother experience for video conferencing and 4K media playbac

features: The world’s first privacy display built into a phone: For the first time ever, you can now limit what others can see on your phone whenever you want by enabling the built-in Privacy Display on Galaxy S26 Ultra. Fast. Powerful. AI-ready.: Reimagine what’s possible with Galaxy S26 Series, featuring our most powerful processor yet. Effortlessly stay connected with context-aware reply suggestions,¹ open and switch between apps and fine-tune photos and videos without skipping a beat.

Remove the mess. Restore the magic: Quickly transform your photos by simply typing or tapping using Photo Assist² with Galaxy AI.³ Did someone take a bite of your dessert before you took the photo? Just type, “Make this piece of cake look perfect,” and your pic is fixed like magic.

Memorable nights, clearly captured: With Galaxy S26, your nights don’t disappear in the dark. Nightography captures concerts, city nights and dinner celebrations with vivid detail —even in low light. Richer color. Sharper detail.: Get into your favorite content like never before. Your screen automatically enhances streaming and social content for richer colors and sharper details you can enjoy clearly. And with scrolling and transitions designed to be smooth, your screen experience becomes even more immersive.
Group selfies made easy: Group selfies shouldn’t take so much effort. With a wider⁷ front camera, it’s easier to capture more people and more of the scene in one simple shot.

Hi-Res Audio. Hands-free AI.: Say hello to the unbeatable duo. Galaxy S26 Ultra and Buds4 Pro⁸ work together as one seamless experience, bringing AI assistance³ right to your ears so you can stay hands-free. Hear messages or get quick answers while getting errands done —all without unlocking your phone. It’s a smarter way to stay in control, whether you’re navigating your day, multitasking on the move or simply trying to stay in the moment.

A digital wallet is already in your Galaxy: Say goodbye to bulky wallets and hello to Samsung Wallet on your Galaxy S26 Series. Securely store and access your debit and credit cards,⁹ loyalty cards, boarding passes¹⁰ and more right from your phone. Check out the Samsung Wallet app in your phone to learn about all the features available and start using it today.

Moving to Galaxy is now easier than ever: Samsung makes moving to Galaxy simple. Bring over the things you expect - like photos and contacts. And the things you don't - like alarms, passwords and eSIMs. Plus, you'll be able to share files and encrypt messages in the same manner you're used to.¹¹

items.name: GoPro - MAX 360 Action Camera - Black
items.description: Max captures everything around you in a stunning 5.6K spherical video while completely erasing your extension pole from the shot. Just point Max anywhere and pick the best angles later. You’ll be able to create immersive point-of-view footage, selfie shots, follow-cam footage and more from the same video. The GoPro Quik app makes it easy to reframe and automatically track objects while powerful editing tools help you create videos that you can share right from your phone. Intuitive camera controls let you tap and swipe to take ultra steady 360-time warp shots and 360 photos or standard video in single lens mode with unbreakable max hyper smooth video stabilization and horizon lock. Rugged, durable, waterproof and mountable, Max is ready to capture your adventures from every angle and perspective.

specifications.Product Name: MAX 360 Action Camera

features: Ultra versatile  360 video: By capturing 5.6K30 spherical video, MAX gives you the freedom to stay in the moment and still get amazing footage. There’s no need to frame the shot. Just hit the shutter button to start recording. Get immersive POV footage of a mountain bike run and shots of you riding from the same video. Slow things down with 3K60 video to capture 2x slo-mo footage of your kids jumping in the pool and everyone’s reaction at poolside as they get hit with the splash.

Easy 360 editing: The GoPro Quik app is packed with features that transform your 360-footage into amazing shareable stories. Object Tracking locks onto your subject and automatically follows it no matter where it roams throughout your spherical footage. You can reframe your 360-footage into standard videos, grab photos and add dramatic transition effects to get exactly the shots you want before posting them right from the app.

Stealth mounting: Capture amazing pole-mounted footage where the pole completely vanishes. Attach MAX to a grip or extension pole using the 1/4-20 mounting threads on the bottom of the camera. The pole will be automatically stitched out of your videos and photos. You can easily create incredible self-capture shots that look as if you’re being recorded by another person and stunning drone-like videos that look like you’re being recorded from the air.

Single lens video, photo + time lapse: Single Lens (HERO) mode gives you the option to capture standard video, photos and time lapse footage just like our HERO cameras. Video can be captured in the 1080p video resolution for full widescreen playback on your phone or TV or the 1440p resolution for taller, more immersive POV footage.

Max hyper smooth video stabilization: Max HyperSmooth video stabilization helps you capture impossibly smooth single-lens footage no matter how much your camera shakes, twists or turns while recording. Bike, skate, ski, chase your kids through the park or get awesome pet POV shots—all of your footage comes out silky smooth. Combined it with Horizon Lock for next-level performance that keeps the horizon perfectly straight.

360 time warp: 360 TimeWarp lets you speed up time by capturing shake-free stabilized time lapse footage while you’re on the move. After recording, reframe your footage to capture it again from different angles and catch things you didn’t see when you first recorded the footage.
In-camera Stitching of 360 video: In-camera stitching lets you easily offload your 360 content to the GoPro Quik app so you can see and edit your footage right away.

Premium 360 Audio: Six microphones capture immersive 360 sound to match max’s immersive footage. Audio options include 360 audio that delivers true-to-life sound that precisely captures everything around you and advanced wind-noise reduction.

Includes an enduro battery: MAX comes with a high-performance 1600mAh enduro battery that helps boost cold-weather performance so you can power through epic ski and snowboard runs and capture majestic winter backcountry footage.
Rugged + Waterproof to 16ft (5m): It’s ready to capture your adventures through snow, mud and more. It’s also waterproof to 16ft (5m) to protect against splashes and drops into the water.
Effortless power pano: Capture panoramic photos without the pan. Max effortlessly snaps 270° distortion-free panoramic photos without having to scan the horizon.

Perfect for vlogging: Max’s dual-lens design is perfect for vlogging. In Single Lens (HERO) mode, the screen can be front-facing so you can see and narrate the scene in front of you or rear-facing so you can perfectly frame yourself in the shot. You can also prioritize sound from either side of the camera no matter which lens you’re using.

Digital lenses: Choose from four digital lenses in Single Lens (HERO) mode to help you get the shot—whether it’s immersive POV shots or stunning landscapes. Simply tap and swipe to switch between narrow, linear, wide and ultra wide max  super view lenses.

Ready to post: Single Lens (HERO) mode lets you capture videos and photos in both widescreen (landscape) or portrait orientation. Choose widescreen capture for full-screen playback on YouTube or on a TV. Record in portrait orientation for posting on social media.

Live streaming in 1080p: Go live in Single Lens (HERO) mode and share while you’re there. Live stream in 1080p on social, get Max HyperSmooth stabilization as you broadcast via the GoPro Quik app and save footage to your SD card to check out later.

Voice control: Call your own shots with 12 voice commands, such as “GoPro, start recording” or “GoPro, take a photo.” Max understands English (US, UK, Australia and India), Chinese (Mandarin), French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, Spanish (Europe and Latin America), and Swedish.

GPS + performance stickers: GPS automatically captures telemetry data that can be overlaid as animated graphics in your video using the GoPro Quik app. It’s a unique visual way to show off your speed, path, terrain, altitude and g-forces while giving your videos an intense professional vibe.

Fast transferring + unlimited cloud backup: Transferring content from your camera to your phone is quick and easy. You can do it through Wi-Fi, choose a lightning-fast wired connection via USB3 or use your SD card to transfer your content to a computer. There’s also unlimited cloud storage with hassle-free auto-upload. Just plug in your camera when connected to your home Wi-Fi and the camera does the rest.

Compatible with GoPro mounts: Bike mounts, surfboard mounts, car mounts, pole mounts, grips, extension poles and more—GoPro has mounts that’ll help you get any shot you can dream up. Capture your adventures from dramatic new angles and see them as you’ve never seen them before, or record point-of-view footage and relive awesome moments exactly as you saw them. Max even has 1/4-20 mounting threads that make it compatible with tripods and other standard camera accessories.

items.name: GoPro - HERO12 Black Action Camera - Black

Tough, lightweight and easily mountable for hands-free recording, it’s ready for anything (on land or in the water) while advanced video stabilization keeps your footage smooth over rough terrain. After recording, simply plug in your GoPro. While it’s charging, your footage will automatically upload to the cloud and be sent to your phone as a highlight video that lets you relive your adventure and share the fun.

features: 360° horizon lock: The HERO12 Black Creator Edition’s Linear with Horizon Lock digital lens keeps your footage steady even if your camera rotates a full 360° during capture. Extra large FOV: The powerful image sensor delivers an expansive field of view. Simply use the GoPro Quik app to zoom in, crop and edit your shots. HERO12 Black exclusive digital lens takes extra-large 8:7 aspect ratio footage and serves it up as a wide-angle 16:9 shot.

Unbelievable image quality: With its 5.3K video that gives you 91% more resolution than 4K and an incredible 665% more than 1080p, HERO12 Black captures the action with crisp detail and cinematic image quality with High Dynamic Range (HDR) while also taking 27MP photos.

High dynamic range video and photo: It takes its premiumn image quality to the next level with HDR for both videos (5.3K and 4K) and photos. HDR captures the details that might typically blend into the darkness of shadows or disappear in the bright spots of your shot.

Compatible with the new max lens mod 2.0: It transform into the ultimate POV camera with the wide field of view (FOV) ever on a HERO camera, at 177° (up from the 155° FOV of the original Max Lens Mod). it delivers stunning 4K resolution plus 1080p video.

HyperSmooth 6.0 stabilization: HERO12 Black makes it even better by maximizing HyperSmooth. Performance with more stabilization while still delivering less image cropping. Bike, skate, ski, chase your kids through the park or get awesome pet POV shots even the shakiest footage comes out silky smooth.

8-Bit, 10-Bit with log video: HERO12 Black lets you choose between capturing 8-bit, 10-bit or Log video. Capable of displaying over 1 billion colors, 10-bit color delivers enhanced color depth, smoother gradations and more realism in your videos, while 8-bit offers smaller file sizes.

Up to 8x slo-mo: Everything is more awesome in slow motion. HERO12 Black lets you record the action at up to 8x slo-mo at resolutions up to 2.7K for playback at normal speed or in super fluid slow motion to catch epic details that you’d never be able to see with the naked eye.

Rugged and waterproof: It's legendary durability can take a beating and keep going, whether you’re ripping through mud, snow or water (down to 33ft/10m). A water-repelling lens cover even helps eliminate lens flare and other artifacts to make your photos and videos even more stunning.

2x longer runtime: It improved battery efficiency combines with the included 1720mAh Enduro battery to deliver 2x increase in 5.3K 60 video runtime on each charge. You’ll get 70 minutes of continuous recording at 5.3K, plus over 1.5 hours at 5.3K and over 2.5 hours of continuous recording at 1080p.

specifications.Product Name: MAX2 360 Action Camera

features: MAX Never Misses With 8K 360 Video: Capture everything around you in 8K 360 video with a single press of the shutter. No need to aim or frame your shot—MAX2 records it all. Save, share, or play back these Ultra HD videos on your phone, TV, or other devices like any standard video.

Invisible Mounting: Capture amazing pole-mounted footage where the pole completely vanishes. Attach MAX2 to an extension pole using the 1/4-20 mounting threads on the bottom of the camera. The pole will disappear out of your videos and photos as if by magic. You can easily create incredible invisible selfies that look as if you’re being recorded by another person, stunning drone-like videos that look like you’re being recorded from the air and other iconic 360 shots.

The Best POV: Max out your creativity and get the widest, tallest, most-immersive point-of-view footage possible including selfies, follow-cam footage and more from the same 360 video. Replaceable Glass Lenses: MAX2’s replaceable lenses are water-repelling and made from super strong optical glass—and if they’re ever scratched, you won’t have to replace the entire camera. Now you can record in extreme conditions knowing that you can simply swap out a damaged lens with a new replacement and get right back into the action without interfering with image quality.
Super Slo-Mo in 360: Slow the action way down with amazing 4K100 spherical video that lets you play back your footage in 3x slow motion. Or go with higher-resolution 5.6K60 video for 2x slow motion.

10-Bit Color in 8K + GP Log: Take world-class imagery to the next level. Capture over 1 billion colors in 8K for more realism and smoother gradations in your videos. Advanced users can use GP-Log to get more detail in their footage while making necessary image corrections in post-production (a lookup table/LUT is provided).

Epic 29MP 360 Photos: Don’t point. Just shoot. MAX2 captures amazing ultra high-res 29MP 360 photos of everything around you. The high-res photos give you the flexibility to crop, zoom, Reframe and more with the Quik app. Create epic photos of the action in front of you, plus reaction shots from the people around you.

Easy Editing With the GoPro Quik App: Editing 360 footage is called Reframing, and the creative possibilities are endless. It’s super easy to pick the shots you want. Then track objects, add dynamic movements and transitions, even use multiple Reframe modes in the same clip—all with just a few taps.

Made-for-360 Modes +CameraFX: MotionFrame makes editing your 360 videos as easy as moving your phone to find the best angles. You can also Keyframe the best shots in your 360 footage. Easy POV + Selfie Modes: MAX2 is the easiest way to get GoPro’s world-famous immersive POV and selfie shots. It automatically plays back your footage from a front-facing 180° view, or the reverse angle for awesome third-person selfies that keep you at the center of the action. Voice control: Call your own shots with 12 voice commands, such as “GoPro, start recording” or “GoPro, take a photo.” Max understands English (US, UK, Australia and India), Chinese (Mandarin), French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, Spanish (Europe and Latin America), and Swedish.

items.name: GoPro - MAX2 Action Camera Accessory Bundle - Black
items.description: This bundle comes with everything you need to capture and share incredible footage. You’ll get GoPro’s powerful and versatile 360 camera—MAX2—plus our 4ft (1.2m) Extension Pole, an extra Enduro battery and a 64GB SD card. No need to aim—MAX2 never misses. It captures everything around you in pro-quality 8K 360 video while completely erasing your extension pole from the shot. You’ll be able to create immersive point-of-view footage, selfies, follow-cam footage and more from the same video. Capture the scene in front of you and your reaction at the same time without worrying about where the lenses are pointed—even in extreme conditions. MAX2 is tough and durable with replaceable lenses.1 Just swap in a new one if a lens is damaged. After recording, automatically play back your footage in POV or Selfie mode or use the GoPro Quik app’s powerful, yet simple editing tools to Reframe your footage into shareable 4K videos. Go vertical for TikTok or widescreen for YouTube, change angles and perspectives, or add pro-quality effects. It’s 360…MAX’D.

specifications.Product Name: MAX2 Action Camera Accessory Bundle

features: MAX Never Misses With 8K 360 Video: Capture everything in stunning 8K 360 with MAX2—no need to aim or frame. Just hit record and let it grab every angle. Then use the GoPro Quik app to Reframe your footage into shareable 4K videos in just a few taps. Play, post, and share with ease.

Invisible Mounting: Capture amazing pole-mounted footage where the pole completely vanishes. Attach MAX2 to the included 4ft (1.2m) extension pole using the 1/4-20 mounting threads on the bottom of the camera. The pole will disappear out of your videos and photos as if by magic. You can easily create incredible invisible selfies that look as if you’re being recorded by another person, stunning drone-like videos that look like you’re being recorded from the air and other iconic 360 shots.

The Best POV: Max out your creativity and get the widest, tallest, mostimmersive point-of-view footage possible including selfies, follow-cam footage and more from the same 360 video. The GoPro Quik app makes it easy to Reframe your footage and create new videos from different angles and perspectives to get exactly the shots you want. You can also adjust video stabilization and Horizon Lock after recording.

Replaceable Glass Lenses: MAX2’s replaceable lenses are water-repelling and made from super strong optical glass—and if they’re ever scratched, you won’t have to replace the entire camera. Now you can record in extreme conditions knowing that you can simply swap out a damaged lens with a new replacement and get right back into the action without interfering with image quality.
Super Slo-Mo in 360: Slow the action way down with amazing 4K100 spherical video that lets you play back your footage in 3x slow motion. Or go with higher-resolution 5.6K60 video for 2x slow motion.

10-Bit Color in 8K + GP Log: Take world-class imagery to the next level. Capture over 1 billion colors in 8K for more realism and smoother gradations in your videos. Advanced users can use GP-Log to get more detail in their footage while making necessary image corrections in postproduction (a lookup table/LUT is provided).

Epic 29MP 360 Photos: Don’t point. Just shoot. MAX2 captures amazing ultra high-res 29MP 360 photos of everything around you. The high-res photos give you the flexibility to crop, zoom, Reframe and more with the Quik app. Create epic photos of the action in front of you, plus reaction shots from the people around you.

Easy Editing With the GoPro Quik App: Editing 360 footage is called Reframing, and the creative possibilities are endless. It’s super easy to pick the shots you want. Then track objects, add dynamic movements and transitions, even use multiple Reframe modes in the same clip— all with just a few taps.

Made-for-360 Modes + CameraFX: MotionFrame makes editing your 360 videos as easy as moving your phone to find the best angles. You can also Keyframe the best shots in your 360 footage. The Quik app will automatically create smooth transitions between them. Add CameraFX to make your videos more exhilarating than ever with pro-level effects like Spin, Flip, Roll, Wobble, Tiny Planet and more.

Easy POV + Selfie Modes: MAX2 is the easiest way to get GoPro’s world-famous, immersive POV and selfie shots. It automatically plays back your footage from a front-facing 180° view, or the reverse angle for awesome third-person selfies that keep you at the center of the action. You’ll still capture everything in 360 when shooting in these modes, so you can explore all the angles.

Vertical + Widescreen Capture: Shoot for TikTok and YouTube at the same time. Capturing 360 footage lets you grab any aspect ratio from any shot. You’ll get the best vertical shots for TikTok and other social platforms, plus the best widescreen footage for full-screen playback on YouTube, your phone or TV without changing any mounting setups.

Single Lens 4K60 Video + Max HyperView: Switch over from 360 to Single Lens mode to capture stunning traditional 4K video with either the front or back lens. It features the 180° Max HyperView digital lens for capturing the tallest, widest and most immersive traditional video field of view ever on a GoPro while enhancing the sense of speed in your footage. You can also record with the Linear, Wide, Ultra Wide and Max SuperView lenses to help you nail any shot.

Unbreakable HyperSmooth Video Stabilization: Max HyperSmooth, our most powerful video stabilization, delivers the smoothest video possible in the roughest conditions. Bike, skate, ski, chase your kids through the park or get awesome pet POV shots—all your footage comes out silky smooth.

360 Horizon Lock: Give your videos the look of professional productions by keeping the horizon perfectly straight and level. Turn Horizon Lock on keep to your footage rock-steady even if your camera was completely rotated, tilted or flipped upside down while recording. Turn it off to capture every twist and turn of your adventure.

True-to-Life 360 Audio: MAX2’s 6 microphones help it deliver immersive sound to match its immersive footage. Audio options include 360 stereo with advanced wind-noise reduction, plus Audio Field-of-View in Single Lens mode that automatically focuses sound recording to match what your camera sees.

Accessories for Any 360 Shot: Extra-long poles, tripods, ball joints and more—GoPro has mounts that’ll help you get iconic shots that are only possible with 360. And it’s never been easier. The new Magnetic Latch Mount1 makes it faster to swap your camera from one mounting setup to another. It also has built-in mounting fingers for use with GoPro mounts and 1/4-20 mounting threads for tripods and other standard camera accessories.

8K 360 TimeWarp: 360 TimeWarp lets you speed up time by capturing silky-smooth, super-thrilling stabilized time lapse footage in glorious 8K while you’re on the move. After recording, reframe your footage to capture it again from different angles and maybe see something you didn’t see when you first recorded the footage.

360 Time Lapse + 360 Night Lapse: Shrink time and turn long events into short shareable 360 time lapse videos during the day or after dark. You’ll be able to record amazing 8K videos or capture a series of 360 time lapse photos that you can look through later for the best shots. 360 Night lapse will even adjust the capture settings for night and low-light shots.

360 Night Effects: MAX2 features 3 time lapse modes that let you get creative with your 360 footage after dark. 360 Star Trails uses the Earth’s rotation and stars to capture beautiful light trails across the night sky. 360 Light Painting lets you create brilliant brush stroke effects with moving light. 360 Vehicle Light Trails uses night-time traffic to record stunning light trail shots.

Schedule Your Shot: Get the shot the easy way with a suite of smart settings that extend your capture options beyond simply pressing the shutter button. Scheduled Capture lets you set your GoPro to turn itself on and capture a shot up to 24 hours in advance.

Timecode Sync: Wirelessly synchronize multiple MAX2s with timecode and the GoPro Quik app. It’s perfect for when you want to capture an activity from multiple angles and then make precise, matchframe edits in post-production. Use matching timecode clips in Adobe Premiere Pro and other applications that support multicamera editing for your next project.

Rugged + Waterproof to 16ft (5m): MAX2 is not only a 360 camera, it’s also a GoPro. It’s made to take a beating and keep going through mud, snow or more. And it’s also waterproof down to 16ft (5m) to protect against splashes and drops into the water. Its replaceable water-repelling lenses even help eliminate lens flares and other artifacts to help keep your footage crystal clear.

Extension Pole: Stretching to 4ft (1.2m) and collapsing to 10in (25cm), this durable extension pole is great for capturing selfie footage, rising above the action or getting closer to it. When used with your MAX2 in 360 mode, the pole completely vanishes out of the shot—letting you create incredible self-capture scenes that look as if you’re being recorded by another person.

Cold-Weather Enduro Battery: MAX2’s 1960mAh Enduro battery delivers exceptional performance in all conditions. It lets you use MAX2 at low temperatures so you can capture amazing ski, snowboard and backcountry footage, plus other winter shots. This accessory bundle includes an extra 1960mAh Enduro battery—for a total of 2—so you’ve always got a spare handy.
64GB SD Card: This SanDisk Extreme 64GB microSDXC card is specially designed to meet the high-performance video resolution and recording demands of your MAX2 camera.

items.name: DJI - RC Pro 2 Controller for Mavic 4 Pro Drone
items.description: DJI RC Pro 2 remote controller puts professional-grade aerial filmmaking at your fingertips. Its powerful 7-inch high-bright Mini-LED display delivers stunning visuals, while the rotatable screen instantly syncs with the drone's gimbal for vertical shooting. The enterprise-level multibeam high-gain antennas ensures ultra-reliable video transmission. With its integrated collapsible design, the RC Pro 2 powers on when extended and automatically deploys its control sticks so you can start creating instantly. Plus, capture high-quality audio with the built-in mic or pair it with the DJI Mic series. From design to experience, DJI RC Pro 2 is the ultimate companion for DJI camera drones.Flagship Display, Unforgettable Visuals DJI RC Pro 2's Mini-LED screen delivers flagship-monitor performance, featuring an ultra-high 2000-nit peak brightness, 1600-nit sustained brightness, and a 1,000,000:1 contrast ratio. It supports 10-bit color and covers 98% of the DCI-P3 color gamut, ensuring exceptional display quality. Not only does it display real-time HDR footage captured by the Mavic 4 Pro, it also accurately reproduces D-Log/D-Log M/HLG video through assistive display functions, giving you precise control over your visuals during creation. Collapsible Design, Extend and Start Creating RC Pro 2 features a smart collapsible design that powers on when extended, with joysticks rising seamlessly alongside the screen for swift, smooth operation. Adjustable screen stands allow you to find the ideal angle, adding a masterful touch to elevate your creative flow.Rotatable Screen for Instant Vertical Shooting When used with Mavic 4 Pro or Mini 4 Pro, RC Pro 2 enables synchronized gimbal rotation, allowing instant vertical shooting when the screen is rotated. In portrait mode, the RC Pro 2 controller's vertical content display area can be up to 5.5 times that of the RC 2 controller, allowing you to make full use of the large screen to view enhanced details.Quick Sleep and Wake Collapsing the screen automatically puts RC Pro 2 into a low-power sleep mode, allowing for quick reactivation when needed. This allows you to seamlessly transition between locations without frequently powering the device on and off, significantly boosting efficiency.Smart Features for Effortless Aerial PhotographyO4+ Transmission for a More Stable SignalDJI RC Pro 2 is compatible with multiple drones, including the DJI Air 3S, DJI Air 3 and DJI Mini 4 Pro. Equipped with enterprise-level high-gain multibeam antennas, it offers a transmission distance of up to 30 km when used with the Mavic 4 Pro, delivering 10-bit HDR transmission for lifelike visuals and an exceptionally stable signal.Dynamic Home Point Support for Convenient Vehicle FilmingWhen controlling the drone from a moving vehicle, RC Pro 2 dynamically updates the home point location in real-time, ensuring Mavic 4 Pro can return safely and quickly to a location near your vehicle.Built-in Simulator and TutorialsThe remote controller includes a built-in flight simulator that replicates real-world flying conditions, operating interfaces, dynamic objects, and even transmission interference, helping beginners quickly learn flight maneuvers.Powerful Performance for High-Quality Live StreamingThird-Party Live Streaming App SupportRC Pro 2's powerful hardware delivers a smooth, flagship-tablet-like experience. Third-party app support enables projection livestreaming and allows you to directly edit downloaded footage and share it to social media from the remote controller-no computer needed.Improved LivestreamingBuilt-in MicRC Pro 2's built-in microphone captures audio and supports direct connection to the DJI Mic series for high-fidelity recording.HDMI PortYou can also use the HDMI port to project UI-free livestreaming footage onto larger screens for sharing.New Dial for Efficient Parameter Adjustment and Image SelectionThe new dial, paired with five-dimensional buttons, is positioned on both sides of the controller for easy thumb control even when wearing gloves, so you can quickly and easily adjust parameters (including aperture, shutter speed, and ISO) and select footage.4-Hour Battery Life, 128GB Large CapacityRC Pro 2 offers 4 hours of battery life, equivalent to flying through four Mavic 4 Pro batteries, making it ideal for shooting and live streaming. It also features 128GB of built-in storage with support for further expansion via microSD card.

items.name: GoPro - HERO13 Black Action Camera Bundle - Black
items.description: HERO13 Black is the camera for every creator. In addition to the 5.3K60 video and legendary GoPro durability, it’s compatible with new HB-Series Lenses. These lenses expand your capture capabilities for the most immersive POV shots, the ability to focus closer than ever, easy-to-achieve motion blur using neutral density filters and cinematic anamorphic footage. A new more powerful Enduro battery extends recording time in all weather conditions, while an updated mounting system gives HERO13 Black more mounting flexibility than any GoPro before it. With essential GoPro features including HyperSmooth 6.0 video stabilization, automatic highlight videos and the ability to auto upload your footage to the cloud, HERO13 Black is a powerful combination of great tech and endless creative possibilities.

specifications.Product Name: HERO13 Black Action Camera Bundle

features: HB-Series Lenses With Auto Detection: HERO13 Black is compatible with the HB-Series Lenses that let you instantly set up your camera for a variety of specialty shots.  It also detects when a lens or filter is attached and automatically adjusts its settings accordingly.

5.3K video: 5.3K video delivers breathtaking image quality with 91% more resolution than 4K and an incredible 665% more than 1080p. HERO13 Black captures the action with crisp detail and exacting image quality so any shot with any lens will look amazing. 5.3K video also lets you grab stunning photos up to 24.7MP from your footage using the GoPro Quik app.

Burst slow-motion: HERO13 Black features our slowest slow-motion ever with the ability to record video clips with the action slowed down to 13x normal speed. You’ll also be able to record short 4x slow-motion clips using our highest 5.3K resolution video to catch epic details that you’d never be able to see with the naked eye.
Webcam + live streaming: Use HERO13 Black as an ultra versatile webcam, or live stream your next activity as you vlog with buttery-smooth HyperSmooth video stabilization and sharp resolution.

HyperSmooth 6.0 stabilization: HyperSmooth 6.0 continues to set the bar for in-camera video stabilization—giving you impossibly smooth footage no matter how rough it gets. HyperSmooth AutoBoost ensures that you’re getting the widest stabilized footage possible by seamlessly adjusting the shot based on your speed and movement.

Built-In 360° horizon: HERO13 Black’s Linear + Horizon Lock digital lens keeps the horizon steady, straight and smooth even if your camera rotates a full 360° during capture. Combined with HyperSmooth video stabilization, Horizon Lock gives your footage the super smooth look of professional productions.

Extended runtimes in all conditions: Spend more time recording and less time charging. A higher-capacity 1900mAh Enduro battery gives you longer runtimes in all conditions, from hot to freezing and everything in between. You’ll get 1.5 hours of continuous recording at 4K30 or 5.3K30, plus over 2.5 hours of continuous recording at 1080p30.

More power options: HERO13 Black has more power options than any GoPro before it. The Contacto Waterproof Magnetic Power Cable and Door Kit features a magnetic link that gives you a quick and simple way to connect to an external power source. The Dual Battery Charger + Integrated Powerbank features its own internal battery that can conveniently charge the 2 included Enduro batteries anywhere. It can also be plugged directly into your camera for extra-long recording sessions.

More mounting flexibility: HERO13 Black features 3 mounting options that make it more versatile than ever. The new Magnetic Latch Mount1 makes it faster and easier to swap your camera from one mounting setup to another. Use the built-in mounting fingers to securely attach your camera to GoPro mounts when you need durable mounting in rough conditions. The 1/4-20 mounting threads can be used with tripods and other standard camera accessories.

Easy hands-free capture: HERO13 Black is packed with features that make it easy to get incredible footage when your hands are busy with handlebars, ski poles, tow ropes and more. It’s compact and light enough to wear comfortably using one of the many available GoPro body mounts. Once mounted, you can use voice commands for the ultimate in hands-free control.

Mounts for every activity: Bike mounts, surfboard mounts, car mounts, pole mounts, grips, extension poles and more. GoPro has mounts that’ll help you get any shot you can dream up. Capture your adventures from dramatic new angles and see them as you’ve never seen them before or record point-of-view footage and relive awesome moments exactly as you saw them.

HLG-HDR video: HERO13 Black takes its best-in-class image quality to the next level with the option to record in Hybrid Log Gamma (HLG), a standard HDR format that the pros use to capture 5.3K and 4K video in the 10-bit and Rec. 2100 color space. This advanced feature requires a compatible display and media player for playback. Users can still capture video using HDR without HLG for viewing on standard displays and media players.

Widescreen, vertical + full screen capture: HERO13 Black’s powerful 1/1.9” image sensor lets you do more. Choose widescreen capture (16:9 aspect ratio) for full-screen playback on a TV or vertical videos (9:16 aspect ratio) for social media posting. For maximum versatility, the full frame option (8:7 aspect ratio) captures a 156° field of view that lets you crop in to create widescreen and vertical shots later.

10-bit color + log encoding: HERO13 Black lets you choose between capturing standard video at 10-bit or Log encoding at 10-bit with GP-Log. Capable of displaying over 1 billion colors, 10-bit color delivers enhanced color depth, smoother gradations and more realism in your videos. Advanced users can use GP-Log to get more detail in their footage while making necessary image corrections in post-production (a lookup table/LUT is provided).

Timecode sync: Advanced users with more than one HERO13 Black can sync them with the exact same timecode to make multi-camera editing a lot easier. It works with Final Cut Pro, Adobe Premiere and other editing software to further streamline post-production.

27MP photos + 24.7MP frame grabs: HERO13 Black takes 27MP Single, Interval, Burst and Night photos that let you capture standard, fast action and low-light shots. You can also grab stunning photos up to 24.7MP of your favorite shots from your videos using the GoPro Quik app.

Bluetooth audio connectivity: Bluetooth audio lets you wirelessly connect HERO13 Black to compatible devices. Use a wireless microphone for enhanced audio when narrating a scene or conducting interviews. By connecting to your wireless earbuds, your GoPro will be able to hear your voice commands in noisy settings or when it’s mounted out of earshot. You’ll also be able to hear camera alerts through your earbuds to confirm that it got the command and is doing what you want.

Audio tuning: Audio Tuning lets you adjust sound recording to better fit what you’re capturing. Choose balanced true-to-life sound that’s great for most shots or the voice setting that enhances vocal clarity while also preserving ambient background sounds.

Quicker QuikCapture: QuikCapture is the fastest and easiest way to power up HERO13 Black and start recording. All it takes is a press of the shutter button. Now you can also set your camera to idle without completely powering down. This lets you start recording again even faster. It’s the perfect way to stay flexible and ready to record during active shoots.

GPS + performance stickers: GPS automatically captures telemetry data that can be overlaid as animated graphics in your video using the GoPro Quik app. It’s a visual way to show off your speed, path, terrain, altitude and g-forces while giving your videos an intense professional vibe.

Front + rear LCD screens: Frame your shots perfectly with either the front or rear LCD screen. Use the large rear touch screen to capture the scene in front of you, or turn your camera around and use the front screen for vlogging and perfectly framed selfies.

More preset options: Create presets of your go-to settings—resolutions, frame rates, lenses and more—for all of your favorite activities and conveniently switch them up in just a few taps. You can personalize them with custom names right on the camera or with the GoPro Quik app.

Highlight videos automatically sent to your phone: Simply plug in your GoPro when connected to your home Wi-Fi. While it’s charging, your footage is automatically uploaded to the cloud and used to make a highlight video complete with beat-synced music and effects. Videos are automatically sent to your phone and ready to share.

Easy editing with the GoPro Quik App: The GoPro Quik app is loaded with easy-to-use tools that let you edit your footage like a pro. You can tweak the automatic highlight videos created by the app or make your own videos from scratch. You also have the flexibility to change digital lenses after recording and zoom in on the best sections of your footage to create high?resolution punchouts that focus on the action while cropping out the rest.

Faster transferring + unlimited cloud backup: Transferring content from your camera to your phone is simpler & faster than ever. HERO13 Black uses Wi-Fi 6 technology for faster, more reliable offloads to your phone & the cloud. You can also use a lightning-fast wired connection via USB5 or use your SD card to transfer your content to a computer. There’s also unlimited cloud storage with hassle-free auto-upload. Just plug in your camera when connected to your home Wi-Fi & the camera does the rest.

items.name: GoPro - HERO13 Black Action Camera - Black
items.description: HERO13 Black is the camera for every creator. In addition to the 5.3K60 video and legendary GoPro durability, it’s compatible with new HB-Series Lenses. These lenses expand your capture capabilities for the most immersive POV shots, the ability to focus closer than ever, easy-to-achieve motion blur using neutral density filters and cinematic anamorphic footage. A new more powerful Enduro battery extends recording time in all weather conditions, while an updated mounting system gives HERO13 Black more mounting flexibility than any GoPro before it. With essential GoPro features including HyperSmooth 6.0 video stabilization, automatic highlight videos and the ability to auto upload your footage to the cloud, HERO13 Black is a powerful combination of great tech and endless creative possibilities.

specifications.Product Name: HERO13 Black Action Camera

features: HB-Series Lenses With Auto Detection: HERO13 Black is compatible with the HB-Series Lenses that let you instantly set up your camera for a variety of specialty shots.  It also detects when a lens or filter is attached and automatically adjusts its settings accordingly.

5.3K video: 5.3K video delivers breathtaking image quality with 91% more resolution than 4K and an incredible 665% more than 1080p. HERO13 Black captures the action with crisp detail and exacting image quality so any shot with any lens will look amazing. 5.3K video also lets you grab stunning photos up to 24.7MP from your footage using the GoPro Quik app.

Burst slow-motion: HERO13 Black features our slowest slow-motion ever with the ability to record video clips with the action slowed down to 13x normal speed. You’ll also be able to record short 4x slow-motion clips using our highest 5.3K resolution video to catch epic details that you’d never be able to see with the naked eye.
Webcam + live streaming: Use HERO13 Black as an ultra versatile webcam, or live stream your next activity as you vlog with buttery-smooth HyperSmooth video stabilization and sharp resolution.

HyperSmooth 6.0 stabilization: HyperSmooth 6.0 continues to set the bar for in-camera video stabilization—giving you impossibly smooth footage no matter how rough it gets. HyperSmooth AutoBoost ensures that you’re getting the widest stabilized footage possible by seamlessly adjusting the shot based on your speed and movement.

Built-In 360° horizon: HERO13 Black’s Linear + Horizon Lock digital lens keeps the horizon steady, straight and smooth even if your camera rotates a full 360° during capture. Combined with HyperSmooth video stabilization, Horizon Lock gives your footage the super smooth look of professional productions.

Extended runtimes in all conditions: Spend more time recording and less time charging. A higher-capacity 1900mAh Enduro battery gives you longer runtimes in all conditions, from hot to freezing and everything in between. You’ll get 1.5 hours of continuous recording at 4K30 or 5.3K30, plus over 2.5 hours of continuous recording at 1080p30.

More power options: HERO13 Black has more power options than any GoPro before it. The Contacto Waterproof Magnetic Power Cable and Door Kit features a magnetic link that gives you a quick and simple way to connect to an external power source. The Dual Battery Charger + Integrated Powerbank features its own internal battery that can conveniently charge the 2 included Enduro batteries anywhere. It can also be plugged directly into your camera for extra-long recording sessions.

More mounting flexibility: HERO13 Black features 3 mounting options that make it more versatile than ever. The new Magnetic Latch Mount1 makes it faster and easier to swap your camera from one mounting setup to another. Use the built-in mounting fingers to securely attach your camera to GoPro mounts when you need durable mounting in rough conditions. The 1/4-20 mounting threads can be used with tripods and other standard camera accessories.

Easy hands-free capture: HERO13 Black is packed with features that make it easy to get incredible footage when your hands are busy with handlebars, ski poles, tow ropes and more. It’s compact and light enough to wear comfortably using one of the many available GoPro body mounts. Once mounted, you can use voice commands for the ultimate in hands-free control.

Mounts for every activity: Bike mounts, surfboard mounts, car mounts, pole mounts, grips, extension poles and more. GoPro has mounts that’ll help you get any shot you can dream up. Capture your adventures from dramatic new angles and see them as you’ve never seen them before or record point-of-view footage and relive awesome moments exactly as you saw them.

HLG-HDR video: HERO13 Black takes its best-in-class image quality to the next level with the option to record in Hybrid Log Gamma (HLG), a standard HDR format that the pros use to capture 5.3K and 4K video in the 10-bit and Rec. 2100 color space. This advanced feature requires a compatible display and media player for playback. Users can still capture video using HDR without HLG for viewing on standard displays and media players.

Widescreen, vertical + full screen capture: HERO13 Black’s powerful 1/1.9” image sensor lets you do more. Choose widescreen capture (16:9 aspect ratio) for full-screen playback on a TV or vertical videos (9:16 aspect ratio) for social media posting. For maximum versatility, the full frame option (8:7 aspect ratio) captures a 156° field of view that lets you crop in to create widescreen and vertical shots later.

10-bit color + log encoding: HERO13 Black lets you choose between capturing standard video at 10-bit or Log encoding at 10-bit with GP-Log. Capable of displaying over 1 billion colors, 10-bit color delivers enhanced color depth, smoother gradations and more realism in your videos. Advanced users can use GP-Log to get more detail in their footage while making necessary image corrections in post-production (a lookup table/LUT is provided).

Timecode sync: Advanced users with more than one HERO13 Black can sync them with the exact same timecode to make multi-camera editing a lot easier. It works with Final Cut Pro, Adobe Premiere and other editing software to further streamline post-production.

27MP photos + 24.7MP frame grabs: HERO13 Black takes 27MP Single, Interval, Burst and Night photos that let you capture standard, fast action and low-light shots. You can also grab stunning photos up to 24.7MP of your favorite shots from your videos using the GoPro Quik app.

Bluetooth audio connectivity: Bluetooth audio lets you wirelessly connect HERO13 Black to compatible devices. Use a wireless microphone for enhanced audio when narrating a scene or conducting interviews. By connecting to your wireless earbuds, your GoPro will be able to hear your voice commands in noisy settings or when it’s mounted out of earshot. You’ll also be able to hear camera alerts through your earbuds to confirm that it got the command and is doing what you want.

Audio tuning: Audio Tuning lets you adjust sound recording to better fit what you’re capturing. Choose balanced true-to-life sound that’s great for most shots or the voice setting that enhances vocal clarity while also preserving ambient background sounds.

Quicker QuikCapture: QuikCapture is the fastest and easiest way to power up HERO13 Black and start recording. All it takes is a press of the shutter button. Now you can also set your camera to idle without completely powering down. This lets you start recording again even faster. It’s the perfect way to stay flexible and ready to record during active shoots.

GPS + performance stickers: GPS automatically captures telemetry data that can be overlaid as animated graphics in your video using the GoPro Quik app. It’s a visual way to show off your speed, path, terrain, altitude and g?forces while giving your videos an intense professional vibe.

Front + rear LCD screens: Frame your shots perfectly with either the front or rear LCD screen. Use the large rear touch screen to capture the scene in front of you, or turn your camera around and use the front screen for vlogging and perfectly framed selfies.

items.name: GoPro - MAX2 360 Action Camera - Black
items.description: MAX2 never misses. It captures everything around you in pro-quality 8K 360 video while completely erasing your extension pole from the shot. You’ll be able to create immersive point-of-view footage, selfies, follow-cam footage and more from the same video. Capture the scene in front of you and your reaction at the same time without worrying about where the lenses are pointed—even in extreme conditions. MAX2 is tough and durable with replaceable lenses.1 Just swap in a new one if a lens is damaged. After recording, automatically play back your footage in POV or Selfie mode or use the GoPro Quik app’s powerful, yet simple editing tools to Reframe your footage into shareable 4K videos. Go vertical for TikTok or widescreen for YouTube, change angles and perspectives, or add pro-quality effects. Incredible image quality, GoPro durability and packed with endless creative possibilities. It’s more than a 360 camera. It’s 360…MAX’D.

specifications.Product Name: MAX2 360 Action Camera

features: MAX Never Misses With 8K 360 Video: Capture everything around you in 8K 360 video with a single press of the shutter. No need to aim or frame your shot—MAX2 records it all. Later, use the GoPro Quik app to reframe your 360 footage into traditional 4K videos with just a few taps. Save, share, or play back these Ultra HD videos on your phone, TV, or other devices like any standard video.

Invisible Mounting: Capture amazing pole-mounted footage where the pole completely vanishes. Attach MAX2 to an extension pole using the 1/4-20 mounting threads on the bottom of the camera. The pole will disappear out of your videos and photos as if by magic. You can easily create incredible invisible selfies that look as if you’re being recorded by another person, stunning drone-like videos that look like you’re being recorded from the air and other iconic 360 shots.

The Best POV: Max out your creativity and get the widest, tallest, most-immersive point-of-view footage possible including selfies, follow-cam footage and more from the same 360 video. The GoPro Quik app makes it easy to Reframe your footage and create new videos from different angles and perspectives to get exactly the shots you want. You can also adjust video stabilization and Horizon Lock3 after recording.

Replaceable Glass Lenses: MAX2’s replaceable lenses are water-repelling and made from super strong optical glass—and if they’re ever scratched, you won’t have to replace the entire camera. Now you can record in extreme conditions knowing that you can simply swap out a damaged lens with a new replacement and get right back into the action without interfering with image quality.
Super Slo-Mo in 360: Slow the action way down with amazing 4K100 spherical video that lets you play back your footage in 3x slow motion. Or go with higher-resolution 5.6K60 video for 2x slow motion.

10-Bit Color in 8K + GP Log: Take world-class imagery to the next level. Capture over 1 billion colors in 8K for more realism and smoother gradations in your videos. Advanced users can use GP-Log to get more detail in their footage while making necessary image corrections in post-production (a lookup table/LUT is provided).

Epic 29MP 360 Photos: Don’t point. Just shoot. MAX2 captures amazing ultra high-res 29MP 360 photos of everything around you. The high-res photos give you the flexibility to crop, zoom, Reframe and more with the Quik app. Create epic photos of the action in front of you, plus reaction shots from the people around you.

Easy Editing With the GoPro Quik App: Editing 360 footage is called Reframing, and the creative possibilities are endless. It’s super easy to pick the shots you want. Then track objects, add dynamic movements and transitions, even use multiple Reframe modes in the same clip—all with just a few taps.

Made-for-360 Modes +CameraFX: MotionFrame makes editing your 360 videos as easy as moving your phone to find the best angles. You can also Keyframe the best shots in your 360 footage. The Quik app will automatically create smooth transitions between them. Add CameraFX to make your videos more exhilarating than ever with pro-level effects like Spin, Flip, Roll, Wobble, Tiny Planet and more.

Easy POV + Selfie Modes: MAX2 is the easiest way to get GoPro’s world-famous immersive POV and selfie shots. It automatically plays back your footage from a front-facing 180° view, or the reverse angle for awesome third-person selfies that keep you at the center of the action. You’ll still capture everything in 360 when shooting in these modes, so you can explore all the angles.

Voice control: Call your own shots with 12 voice commands, such as “GoPro, start recording” or “GoPro, take a photo.” Max understands English (US, UK, Australia and India), Chinese (Mandarin), French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese (Brazil), Russian, Spanish (Europe and Latin America), and Swedish.

GPS + performance stickers: GPS automatically captures telemetry data that can be overlaid as animated graphics in your video using the GoPro Quik app. It’s a unique visual way to show off your speed, path, terrain, altitude and g-forces while giving your videos an intense professional vibe.

Fast transferring + unlimited cloud backup: Transferring content from your camera to your phone is quick and easy. You can do it through Wi-Fi, choose a lightning-fast wired connection via USB3 or use your SD card to transfer your content to a computer. There’s also unlimited cloud storage with hassle-free auto-upload. Just plug in your camera when connected to your home Wi-Fi and the camera does the rest.

Compatible with GoPro mounts: Bike mounts, surfboard mounts, car mounts, pole mounts, grips, extension poles and more—GoPro has mounts that’ll help you get any shot you can dream up. Capture your adventures from dramatic new angles and see them as you’ve never seen them before, or record point-of-view footage and relive awesome moments exactly as you saw them. Max even has 1/4-20 mounting threads that make it compatible with tripods and other standard camera accessories.

Next Generation GP3 Processor: With 2x the power of our previous GP2 chip, the revolutionary GP3 SoC (system on chip) delivers higher resolutions at extremely high frame rates for smoother motion and slow-motion playback. It also powers dual AI engines that run advanced denoising algorithms for amazing low-light capture.

Best-in-Class Video With 8K Open Gate: 8K video delivers breathtaking image quality with 300% more resolution than 4K. MISSION 1 PRO takes it even further with Open Gate capture that uses the full image sensor for maximum height and width for the most post-production flexibility.

Over 3 Hours of 4K Runtime + Faster Charging: You’ll get over 3 hours of continuous 4K30 recording and over 5 hours of 1080p30 recording on a single charge while improved heat management helps prevent thermal shutdown.1 It’s also capable of rapid charging so there’s less downtime and more production time. It’s also capable of rapid charging so there’s less downtime and more production time. You can also use Enduro for HERO13 Black batteries as spares

Choose widescreen capture (16:9 aspect ratio) for full-screen playback on a TV or vertical videos (9:16 aspect ratio) for social media posting. For maximum versatility, the full frame option (8:7 aspect ratio) captures a 156° field of view that lets you crop in to create widescreen and vertical shots later.

10-bit color + log encoding: HERO13 Black lets you choose between capturing standard video at 10-bit or Log encoding at 10-bit with GP-Log. Capable of displaying over 1 billion colors, 10-bit color delivers enhanced color depth, smoother gradations and more realism in your videos. Advanced users can use GP-Log to get more detail in their footage while making necessary image corrections in post-production (a lookup table/LUT is provided).

Timecode sync: Advanced users with more than one HERO13 Black can sync them with the exact same timecode to make multi-camera editing a lot easier. It works with Final Cut Pro, Adobe Premiere and other editing software to further streamline post-production.

27MP photos + 24.7MP frame grabs: HERO13 Black takes 27MP Single, Interval, Burst and Night photos that let you capture standard, fast action and low-light shots. You can also grab stunning photos up to 24.7MP of your favorite shots from your videos using the GoPro Quik app.

Bluetooth audio connectivity: Bluetooth audio lets you wirelessly connect HERO13 Black to compatible devices. Use a wireless microphone for enhanced audio when narrating a scene or conducting interviews. By connecting to your wireless earbuds, your GoPro will be able to hear your voice commands in noisy settings or when it’s mounted out of earshot. You’ll also be able to hear camera alerts through your earbuds to confirm that it got the command and is doing what you want.

Audio tuning: Audio Tuning lets you adjust sound recording to better fit what you’re capturing. Choose balanced true-to-life sound that’s great for most shots or the voice setting that enhances vocal clarity while also preserving ambient background sounds.

Quicker QuikCapture: QuikCapture is the fastest and easiest way to power up HERO13 Black and start recording. All it takes is a press of the shutter button. Now you can also set your camera to idle without completely powering down. This lets you start recording again even faster. It’s the perfect way to stay flexible and ready to record during active shoots.

GPS + performance stickers: GPS automatically captures telemetry data that can be overlaid as animated graphics in your video using the GoPro Quik app. It’s a visual way to show off your speed, path, terrain, altitude and g?forces while giving your videos an intense professional vibe.

Front + rear LCD screens: Frame your shots perfectly with either the front or rear LCD screen. Use the large rear touch screen to capture the scene in front of you, or turn your camera around and use the front screen for vlogging and perfectly framed selfies.

More preset options: Create presets of your go-to settings—resolutions, frame rates, lenses and more—for all of your favorite activities and conveniently switch them up in just a few taps. You can personalize them with custom names right on the camera or with the GoPro Quik app.

Highlight videos automatically sent to your phone: Simply plug in your GoPro when connected to your home Wi-Fi. While it’s charging, your footage is automatically uploaded to the cloud and used to make a highlight video complete with beat-synced music and effects. Videos are automatically sent to your phone and ready to share.

Easy editing with the GoPro Quik App: The GoPro Quik app is loaded with easy-to-use tools that let you edit your footage like a pro. You can tweak the automatic highlight videos created by the app or make your own videos from scratch. You also have the flexibility to change digital lenses after recording and zoom in on the best sections of your footage to create high?resolution punchouts that focus on the action while cropping out the rest.

Faster transferring + unlimited cloud backup: Transferring content from your camera to your phone is simpler & faster than ever. HERO13 Black uses Wi-Fi 6 technology for faster, more reliable offloads to your phone & the cloud. You can also use a lightning-fast wired connection via USB5 or use your SD card to transfer your content to a computer. There’s also unlimited cloud storage with hassle-free auto-upload. Anamorphic Lens Mod: Capture cinematic shots in the ultra wide-angle 21:9 aspect ratio with reduced distortion and corner aberrations. Ideal for static shots and stabilized gimbal footage of low vibration activities, the Anamorphic Lens Mod also features horizontal lens flares that add the professional touch of feature films to your footage. In-camera “de-squeezing” lets you see your footage on camera right after recording and eliminates the need to de-squeeze in post-production.

ND Filters: Included ND4, ND8, ND16 and ND32 filters so you can choose the one that works best for your activity and lighting conditions. Auto Cinematic video mode makes it easy for first-time neutral density (ND) filter users to produce shots with motion blur.
Automatic Lens Detection: Simply twist each mod on and off. HERO13 Black detects which lens or filter is attached and automatically adjusts its settings so you’re instantly ready to get the shot.

Burst Slo-Mo: HERO13 Black features our slowest slo-mo ever with the ability to record video clips with the action slowed down to 13x normal speed. You’ll also be able to record short 4x slo-mo clips using our highest 5.3K resolution video to catch epic details that you’d never be able to see with the naked eye.

Rugged + Waterproof: HERO13 Black was built to take a beating. It’s ready to capture the fun on any adventure whether you’re tearing through mud, snow or water (down to 33ft/10m) with the standard lens. Water-repelling lens coatings on all lenses and filters help keep your photos and videos crystal clear.

Award-Winning HyperSmooth 6.0 Stabilization: HyperSmooth 6.0 continues to set the bar for in-camera video stabilization—giving you impossibly smooth footage no matter how rough it gets. HyperSmooth AutoBoost ensures that you’re getting the widest stabilized footage possible by seamlessly adjusting the shot based on your speed and movement. HyperSmooth works with all Lens Mods and gets even more buttery smooth when used with the Ultra Wide Lens Mod.

Built-In 360° Horizon Lock: HERO13 Black’s Linear + Horizon Lock digital lens keeps the horizon steady, straight and smooth even if your camera rotates a full 360° during capture. Combined with HyperSmooth video stabilization, Horizon Lock gives your footage the super smooth look of professional productions.

Extended Runtimes in All Conditions: Spend more time recording and less time charging. A higher-capacity 1900mAh Enduro battery gives you longer runtimes in all conditions, from hot to freezing and everything in between. You’ll get 1.5 hours of continuous recording at 4K30 or 5.3K30, plus over 2.5 hours of continuous recording at 1080p30.

More Power Options: HERO13 Black has more power options than any GoPro before it. The Contacto Waterproof Magnetic Power Cable and Door Kit features a magnetic link that gives you a quick and simple way to connect to an external power source for extra-long recording sessions and easy battery charging.

More Mounting Flexibility: HERO13 Black features 3 mounting options that make it more versatile than ever. The new Magnetic Latch Mount makes it faster and easier to swap your camera from one mounting setup to another. Use the built-in mounting fingers to securely attach your camera to GoPro mounts when you need durable mounting in rough conditions. The 1/4-20 mounting threads can be used with tripods and other standard camera accessories.

HLG-HDR Video: HERO13 Black takes its best-in-class image quality to the next level with the option to record in Hybrid Log Gamma (HLG), a standard HDR format that the pros use to capture 5.3K and 4K video in the 10- bit and Rec. 2100 color space. This advanced feature requires a compatible display and media player for playback. Users can still capture video using HDR without HLG for viewing on standard displays and media players.

10-Bit Color + Log Encoding: HERO13 Black lets you choose between capturing standard video at 10-bit or Log encoding at 10-bit with GP-Log. Capable of displaying over 1 billion colors, 10-bit color delivers enhanced color depth, smoother gradations and more realism in your videos. Advanced users can use GP-Log to get more detail in their footage while making necessary image corrections in post-production (a lookup table/LUT is provided).

Bluetooth Audio Connectivity: Bluetooth audio lets you wirelessly connect HERO13 Black to compatible devices. Use a wireless microphone for enhanced audio when narrating a scene or conducting interviews. By connecting to your wireless earbuds, your GoPro will be able to hear your voice commands in noisy settings or when it’s mounted out of earshot. You’ll also be able to hear camera alerts through your earbuds to confirm that it got the command and is doing what you want.

Audio Tuning: Audio Tuning lets you adjust sound recording to better fit what you’re capturing. Choose balanced true-to-life sound that’s great for most shots or the Voice setting that enhances vocal clarity while also preserving ambient background sounds.

Quicker QuikCapture: QuikCapture is the fastest and easiest way to power up HERO13 Black and start recording. All it takes is a press of the shutter button. Now you can also set your camera to idle without completely powering down. This lets you start recording again even faster. It’s the perfect way to stay flexible and ready to record during active shoots.

GPS + Performance Stickers: GPS automatically captures telemetry data that can be overlaid as animated graphics in your video using the GoPro Quik app. It’s a visual way to show off your speed, path, terrain, altitude and gforces while giving your videos an intense professional vibe.

More Preset Options: Create presets of your go-to settings—resolutions, frame rates, lenses and more—for all of your favorite activities and conveniently switch them up in just a few taps. You can personalize them with custom names right on the camera or with the GoPro Quik app.

Easy Editing With the GoPro Quik App: The GoPro Quik app is loaded with easy-to-use tools that let you edit your footage like a pro. You can tweak the automatic highlight videos created by the app or make your own videos from scratch. You also have the flexibility to change digital lenses after recording and zoom in on the best sections of your footage to create high resolution punchouts that focus on the action while cropping out the rest.

Faster Transferring + Unlimited Cloud Backup: Transferring content from your camera to your phone is simpler and faster than ever. HERO13 Black uses Wi-Fi 6 technology for faster, more reliable offloads to your phone and the cloud. You can also choose a lightning-fast wired connection via USB5 or use your SD card to transfer content to a computer. There’s unlimited cloud storage with hassle-free auto-upload. Just plug in your camera when connected to your home Wi-Fi and the camera does the rest.

Night Effects Video + Photos: HERO13 Black features 3 time lapse and photo modes that let you get creative after dark. Star Trails uses the Earth’s rotation and stars to capture beautiful light trails across the night sky. Light Painting lets you create brilliant brush stroke effects with moving light. Vehicle Light Trails uses night-time traffic to record stunning light trail shots.

Power Tools: Nail any shot with in-camera Power Tools. HindSight captures up to 30 seconds of footage before you start recording—even if you press the shutter too late, you’ll still get the shot. With Scheduled Capture, you can set your GoPro to turn itself on and get a shot up to 24 hours in advance. Duration Capture makes it easy to capture video clips from 15 seconds to 3 hours long. Interval Photo snaps photos at fixed intervals while you stay focused on your favorite activities.

Easy or Pro Controls: Choose point-and-shoot simplicity or full camera control. With Easy Controls, just frame your shot and hit the shutter button for amazing results. The Pro controls unlock the ability to fine-tune all modes, settings and features.
